skill.displayName: Jira BUG Analysis Assistant[Jira-BUG分析助手]
skill.summary: 从 Jira Server/DC 拉取 Bug 数据，进行全面的 AI 分析，并生成交互式 HTML 报表。 分析维度包括：Bug 趋势、优先级/严重程度分布、组件热点、解决时间、经办人负载、 未解决 Bug 老化等。当用户要求分析 Jira Bug、生成 Bug 报表、或查看 Bug 指标时使用此 Skill。

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — enables comprehensive AI-driven Jira Bug analysis and interactive HTML report generation.

- Connects to Jira Server/Data Center, supports both PAT and username/password authentication.
- Pulls and analyzes Bug data across multiple dimensions: trends, priority/severity, components, resolution time, assignee workload, aging, labels.
- Generates a fully self-contained, dynamic HTML report with embedded SVG charts and interactive tables; no external dependencies.
- Includes a client-side Excel export function for raw Bug data.
- Supports robust error handling, detailed parameter guidance, and dynamic, data-driven rendering of all report content.
